newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Cash Grain PM - Some corn, soy bids up - May 14.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Cash Grain PM - Some corn, soy bids up - May 14.

text.p: Some corn and soybean basis bids edged higher Wednesday as farmers continued to focus mostly on getting their corn and soybean crops planted, dealers said.
"It's deathly quiet here." said one western Corn Belt dealer. "We're not buying a thing."
Planting progress throughout the Midwest varied, with some in the East reporting conditions were too wet and cool for farmers to resume seeding Wednesday.
Unseasonably cool temperatures have meant that soil remained saturated in many areas, but some forecasters are showing warmer weather for the weekend, dealers said.
"They're (farmers) waiting for warmer weather this weekend," said one Toledo, Ohio-based dealer. "It's supposed to be in the 70s (degrees Fahrenheit) by Sunday, so that should help."
In the western Corn Belt states, soils were drier and planting progress was speedier, dealers in the region said.
